hardware: Apple Silicon M4 SoC (16 GB Unified RAM, Metal MPS)
measurement_note: Wall-clock timing of 1,000 consecutive end-to-end inference cycles in a single process on an otherwise idle M4. Run-to-run means depend strongly on concurrent system load: the canonical published run gives 16.55 ms mean, while two re-runs performed on 2026-11-15 with a browser saturating a CPU core gave 19.09 ms (median 18.94, p99 21.66) and 19.52 ms (p99 23.07). Reported headline values are the canonical idle-machine artifact; loaded_system_runs lists the real measurements taken under load.
